title: Snapmaker U1 Multi-Toolhead 3D Printer ‐ $1,099 + Delivery @ Snapmaker AU
body:
Deal: Snapmaker U1 Multi-Toolhead 3D Printer ‐ $1,099 + Delivery @ Snapmaker AU

[dda] Just to clarify, do the subscription code, referral code and upgrade code all stack?
[3dprintdeals] I think they might. I don't have an upgrade code to test yet.
[tomz0r] Referral and upgrade don't stack. Just tried. NEW15 works with upgrade though
[dda] Thanks. How long did your upgrade code take to come through?
[Obey] Stuck between X2D and U1. I currently have an A1 mini combo which is great but want to upgrade to something with larger build plate. Thoughts?
[3dprintdeals] Go U1.
Went from A1 to U1.
270mm has been useful, some things I wouldn't have fit on 256mm.
Unless you plan to print ABS/ASA.
U1 can do it but needs panda breath and top lid.
[Bazzaaa] I have some JBHIFI vouchers. Any tricks to get it even cheaper at JB before I buy?
[3dprintdeals] Wait until black friday or another perka code to stack.
If they repeat a site wide code like yesterday.
[3dprintdeals] All codes are referral and affiliate codes
[tomz0r] Half the referral links go to shop.snapmaker.com instead of au.snapmaker.com as users have added them wrong. Make sure you go to au.snapmaker.com and it auto adds the referral code discount (5off)
[3dprintdeals] I mentioned it in OP and have requested mods to updare the referral program
[tomz0r] You sure did! Sorry - haven't had my coffee yet. And thanks for posting all these deals btw <3
[internet-stranger] U1 or FF creator 5 pro ? Tough choice :/
[3dprintdeals] Both are great options.
C5P great value when it drops to $999 with 20% codes.
C5P has top lid, heated chamber and filtration as stock making it ready for ABS/ASA.
U1 has slightly bigger 270mm bed, arguably better software and open source, and automatic feeders.
Heated chamber for U1 needs biqu panda breath or official top lid.
[Loracks] Are the referral codes in the forum somewhere?
[tomz0r] Scroll up and see the grey box under the post description. Do read OPs note on it though.
5% Referral Code
Use the OzBargain referral program to get 5% off.
This is different from US Snapmaker site, make sure you use one that goes to https://au.snapmaker.com/?ref=######
[Sammyboy] Any official accessories that should be purchased? As usual US store has accessories on sale and AU store doesnt.
[3dprintdeals] Don't really need any.
If you want, get a cryo grip plate from aliexpress
